# Argument types BigQuery rejects in approximate aggregate functions, though GoogleSQL accepts
# them; BigQuery's answers to unverified/function_types.txt.

# APPROX_TOP_COUNT and APPROX_TOP_SUM reject every STRUCT and ARRAY value, naming STRUCT or ARRAY
# even when a field or element is a RANGE or INTERVAL.
SELECT ARRAY_LENGTH(APPROX_TOP_COUNT(s, 2))
FROM UNNEST([STRUCT(1 AS x, RANGE<DATE> '[2024-01-01, 2024-02-01)' AS span)]) AS s
=> error contains: Unsupported type STRUCT for aggregate function APPROX_TOP_COUNT

SELECT ARRAY_LENGTH(APPROX_TOP_COUNT(s, 2)) FROM UNNEST([STRUCT(1 AS x, 'a' AS y)]) AS s
=> error contains: Unsupported type STRUCT for aggregate function APPROX_TOP_COUNT

SELECT ARRAY_LENGTH(APPROX_TOP_SUM(s, 1, 2)) FROM UNNEST([STRUCT(1 AS x, 'a' AS y)]) AS s
=> error contains: Unsupported type STRUCT for aggregate function APPROX_TOP_SUM

SELECT ARRAY_LENGTH(APPROX_TOP_COUNT(a, 2)) FROM UNNEST([STRUCT([1] AS a)])
=> error contains: Unsupported type ARRAY for aggregate function APPROX_TOP_COUNT

SELECT ARRAY_LENGTH(APPROX_TOP_SUM(a, 1, 2)) FROM UNNEST([STRUCT([1] AS a)])
=> error contains: Unsupported type ARRAY for aggregate function APPROX_TOP_SUM

SELECT ARRAY_LENGTH(APPROX_TOP_COUNT(a, 2))
FROM UNNEST([STRUCT([RANGE<DATE> '[2024-01-01, 2024-02-01)'] AS a)])
=> error contains: Unsupported type ARRAY for aggregate function APPROX_TOP_COUNT

SELECT ARRAY_LENGTH(APPROX_TOP_COUNT(a, 2)) FROM UNNEST([STRUCT([INTERVAL 1 DAY] AS a)])
=> error contains: Unsupported type ARRAY for aggregate function APPROX_TOP_COUNT

SELECT ARRAY_LENGTH(APPROX_TOP_SUM(a, 1, 2))
FROM UNNEST([STRUCT([RANGE<DATE> '[2024-01-01, 2024-02-01)'] AS a)])
=> error contains: Unsupported type ARRAY for aggregate function APPROX_TOP_SUM

SELECT ARRAY_LENGTH(APPROX_TOP_SUM(a, 1, 2)) FROM UNNEST([STRUCT([INTERVAL 1 DAY] AS a)])
=> error contains: Unsupported type ARRAY for aggregate function APPROX_TOP_SUM

# JSON values aren't groupable or orderable.
SELECT APPROX_COUNT_DISTINCT(j) FROM UNNEST([JSON '1', JSON '1']) AS j
=> error contains: The argument to APPROX_COUNT_DISTINCT must support grouping; Type JSON does not

SELECT ARRAY_LENGTH(APPROX_QUANTILES(j, 2)) FROM UNNEST([JSON '1']) AS j
=> error contains: Argument 1 to APPROX_QUANTILES must support ordering; Type JSON does not
